verdict.rationale: Keycloak ships hosted, server-rendered pages covering the whole story: self-registration and forgot-password flows, an Account Console where users update their profile, change passwords and set up 2FA, and terms or progressive-profiling steps at sign-up. These pages can be restyled through themes and internationalization. Community reports confirm production use with a custom-themed UI, but note that adding custom pages beside the login flow requires extending Keycloak, and that restricting self-service email changes was difficult. missing for 10: in-depth evidence on theme customization (only headline mentions), embeddable framework-native UI components, easier custom-page extensibility without writing providers.
